title: Autodesk RasterImageDef API parent-role evidence boundary
scope: Check whether Autodesk's public ObjectARX and .NET RasterImageDef documentation resolves the DWG IMAGEDEF parentHandle role conflict documented in the existing physical AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 profile.

sources.title: RasterImageDef Class
sources.observation: RasterImageDef objects are stored in ISM_RASTER_IMAGE_DICT and work with RasterImage entities. The page does not specify the DWG parentHandle field or its handle-reference type.

sources.title: AcDbRasterImage::setReactorId
sources.observation: Each image entity has a persistent reactor attached to its image definition; the image entity owns the reactor object. This establishes the reactor relationship, not the IMAGEDEF parentHandle role.

sources.title: Attach and Scale a Raster Image (.NET)
sources.observation: The example inserts the RasterImageDef into the image dictionary, assigns it to a RasterImage, and associates the raster definition. It does not expose parent-handle ownership or erase/copy semantics.

sources.title: AcDbDictionary::setTreatElementsAsHard
sources.observation: A dictionary can be configured to treat its entries as hard- or soft-owned. The generic API description does not establish the setting or the parentHandle type for IMAGEDEF.

sources.title: About Object Ownership (DXF)
sources.observation: The named-object dictionary uses hard ownership for its entries; this generic description is not specific to ACAD_IMAGE_DICT or the IMAGEDEF parent field.

joinedEvidence.existingPhysicalFinding: Four AutoCAD SAVEAS pairs encode the IMAGEDEF parent observation as DWG handle code 0xC and emit the corresponding DXF IMAGEDEF group 330; the ACAD_IMAGE_DICT entry uses group 350. ODA v5.4.1 §2.13 defines 0xC as soft-pointer, while §20.4.81 describes IMAGEDEF parenthandle as hard-owner.
joinedEvidence.interpretation: The API documentation confirms the image dictionary and reactor graph, but does not resolve the conflicting reference type on the IMAGEDEF parent field. Dictionary membership, image-instance reactors, and the object's common parent reference remain separate graph roles.

implementationDecision: No parser or writer change. Preserve the raw source role as unqualified and retain strict output refusal.
nextEvidence: Use a version-bound native ObjectARX probe to inspect IMAGEDEF parentId reference type and behavior through create, save/reopen, erase/unerase, copy, and WBLOCK operations, alongside the dictionary entry and reactor graph. Bind executable, module, DWG/DXF bytes, version, and observed roles. Only then decide whether the current DXF group-330 output preserves semantics.
limitations: The API pages describe class use and related object relationships, not the serialized IMAGEDEF parentHandle field.
No native AutoCAD/ObjectARX runtime was executed in this research slice.
The existing physical cohort is one source saved to four releases and does not resolve deletion or object-copy semantics.
